repos_data.description: TouchDesigner MCP server, describe a visual to Claude, Cursor or Codex and it builds a real, playable node network (audio-reactive, generative, particle, 3D, feedback) with live knobs + MIDI/OSC/DMX, then checks for errors and previews its own work.
Festival light show for your Mac that locks to the beat of whatever you're playing. Swift + Metal.
